label: Stock dsh (no code-index plugin)
description: Control arm. dsh alone, using only its built-in tools (glob/grep/read/LSP if the host provides it). No dsh-code-index plugin loaded.

dsh.versionNote: Pinned to the @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools version declared in dsh-code-index devDependencies. Re-pin and re-verify before a campaign; write the observed `dsh --version` into every run record.

notes: args is intentionally empty: run.mjs passes the prompt/system/result paths through DSH_BENCH_* environment variables so any dsh wrapper can consume them without the bench inventing CLI flags.
